zh: 本地协助可离线查看紧急号码和使领馆目录，也可出示中文求助卡。聊天页可打开 SOS，求助草稿只保存在本机。
常用语卡片可放大、朗读；地铁指南提供北京、上海和成都的乘车步骤及官方线路图。
支付开通指南介绍支付宝和微信支付的境外卡绑定步骤及常见问题。汇率换算新增欧洲央行参考汇率，含人民币，并显示汇率日期。
打车可从行程选地点、查看估价或在滴滴打开。中文地址可直接给司机看。
en: Use Local Support offline to view emergency numbers, find embassies and consulates, or show a help card in Chinese. Open SOS from Chat. Help drafts stay on this device.
Phrase cards show and read common phrases. The Metro Guide covers Beijing, Shanghai and Chengdu, with links to official maps.

The Payment Setup Guide explains how to link an international card in Alipay or Weixin Pay and what to check when setup fails. Currency Converter shows the ECB reference rates and their date, including Chinese yuan.
Use a trip stop to get a taxi estimate, open DiDi, or show the pickup or destination address in Chinese.

zh: 构建 53 接续构建 51。翻译的文字、语音、图片均使用在线千问。
en: Build 53 follows build 51. Text, voice and photo translation use Qwen online.

zh: 用默认字号测中英界面，打开旧对话、切后台再恢复，核对草稿；再测三种翻译和打车预填。在汇率换算里试一次人民币换算，核对来源日期。
开飞行模式查看本地协助、使馆、中文卡和草稿。请勿拨打任何号码。滴滴只走到确认页，请勿下单。
遇到问题，请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录及发生时间。
en: At the default text size, check both languages. Reopen an earlier chat, return from the background, and confirm the draft. Try all three translation modes and taxi prefill. Convert a yuan amount and check the rate date.
In airplane mode, check Local Support, embassies, the Chinese cards and drafts. Do not place any calls. In DiDi, stop at vehicle confirmation without ordering.
Share a screenshot, the copied issue record and the time it happened in the internal testing group.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 酒店、照片内译文、千问朗读、附近、天气、航班、上网卡、玩乐暂未开放。
本地协助暂不发送求助消息，也不会从对话自动触发。查看当前位置的中文地址和医疗卡尚未开放。
en: Hotels, translated photo layouts, Qwen voice playback, Nearby, Weather, Flights, eSIM and Activities are unavailable in this build.
Local Support does not send help requests or open automatically from chat. The Chinese address lookup and medical card are unavailable.

zh: 翻译和打车需要联网，供已开通的内测账号使用。滴滴决定实际价格。打车只在滴滴继续。
en: Translation and taxi estimates require internet access and an enabled tester account. DiDi sets the final price and handles the ride.

zh: 翻译页改成上下双卡。上面输入文字、录音或选图，下面查看译文。底部可切换文字、语音和拍照，最近翻译从右上角打开。
en: Translation now has an input card above the result card. Add text, a recording, or a photo at the top and see the translation below. Switch modes at the bottom and open recent translations from the top right.

zh: 与构建 50 相比，切换输入方式会保留文字草稿，打开最近翻译会保留当前结果。照片译文仍逐行对照。
en: Compared with build 50, switching input modes keeps your text draft. Opening recent translations keeps the current result. Photo translations remain paired line by line.

zh: 核对上下双卡、互换语言、切换输入方式和打开最近翻译。用「完成」、点空白和上滑收起键盘，确认草稿仍在。核对聊天、行程、插件、记忆的顺序。
账号开通后，文字中英各三条，语音中英各三次（含无声录音），再测菜单、路牌、小票、药品说明各三张照片。
抽测构建 49 的第 1、3、4 项。强退重开恢复旧对话和草稿，历史打开旧和新对话，切后台 10 秒及锁屏 60 秒后恢复。
en: Check the two cards, language swap, mode switching and recent translations. Use Done, tap an empty spot and swipe up to dismiss the keyboard. Verify that the text draft stays and the tabs appear in Chat, Trips, Tools, Memory order.
Once your account is enabled, translate three texts and three recordings in each direction, including a silent recording. Test three photos each of menus, signs, receipts, and medicine instructions.
Repeat build 49 checks 1, 3, and 4. Restore an older chat and draft after a force-quit, open both chats from history, then return after 10 seconds in the background and 60 seconds locked.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 翻译需要联网。真实千问翻译等账号开通后再测。
en: Translation requires an internet connection. Wait until your account is enabled before checking live translation.

zh: 本版调整翻译页面。账号资格与真实翻译复测通知见 #1274。
en: This build updates the Translation screen. See #1274 for account enablement and the live translation retest.
